payload.description_html: Summary phylogeny of early osteichthyans showing the scale transformation in posterior ledge, peg-socket articulation and anterodorsal process. This cladogram is simplified from the strict consensus tree of the 1248 most parsimonious trees (Supplementary Fig. 4). l.p (developed), developed posterior ledge; l.p (weak), weak posterior ledge; −l.p, posterior ledge absent; p (broad), broad peg; p (narrow), narrow peg; +p.ad, anterodorsal process; −p.ad, anterodorsal process absent; +p.av, anteroventral process; −p.av, anteroventral process absent; +p.v, ventral process.
